sections.Profile:
"Double Action" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in December 1958. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, the game features four flippers, five pop bumpers, two slingshots, two standup targets, and a gobble hole.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1958
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Wood Rail, Original Theme
